narrative:
Cohezion has successfully implemented a local-first AI engineering platform optimized for the AMD Strix Halo architecture, utilizing the Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 to achieve zero-cost local inference. By establishing a sophisticated routing hierarchy that transitions from NPU to iGPU, CPU, and finally the cloud, the platform eliminates significant operational overhead; for instance, a 10k-token compound loop costs $0.00 on local silicon compared to approximately $0.18 in a cloud environment. The deployment of a tiered model ladder, including the new 6.5GB Gemma-4-12B-QAT, ensures high-speed local execution by filling critical memory-pressure gaps, preventing costly or slow fallbacks to the CPU or cloud when larger models like the 26B-A4B cannot fit in memory.

The platform’s intelligence is further enhanced by smart capability routing and a robust local-first research pipeline. By suppressing chain-of-thought in larger models like Gemma-26B, Cohezion achieves higher-precision results at zero cost. This local execution extends to data ingestion, where RSS and newsletter miners process large HTML files locally to preserve cloud context budgets. To ensure absolute reliability, the agent performs rigorous verification of every GitHub repository and arXiv ID prior to citation, effectively eliminating model fabrication. Furthermore, integrated Claude-usage throttling monitors plan spend—currently at 29% of capacity—and automatically shifts computational loops to local inference to maintain budget efficiency.

Engineering rigor is maintained through a non-destructive V-model wiring sweep, which has successfully processed 47 of approximately 80 code packages. This process ensures every module is reachable via real static import edges, wiring orphans rather than deleting them to maintain a zero-orphan state at the top level. This self-improvement loop is governed by a strict anti-gaming doctrine, where new couplings are only validated if they pass specific behavioral tests. Finally, Cohezion continues to demonstrate competitive technical prowess, having banked a 0.84 floor score in the Kaggle Nemotron competition with a full v10 run currently in progress.
